title: Podaci u cloudu: životni ciklus, skladištenje i zaštita
summary: Cloud data lifecycle, disperzija i tokovi podataka, tipovi storagea i njihove prijetnje, te tehnike zaštite: šifrovanje i envelope encryption, tokenizacija, hashing i potpisi, DLP, masking, anonimizacija i pseudonimizacija, upravljanje ključevima, tajnama i certifikatima.
title_en: Cloud data: lifecycle, storage and protection
summary_en: The cloud data lifecycle, data dispersion and data flows, storage types and their threats, and protection techniques: encryption and envelope encryption, tokenization, hashing and signatures, DLP, masking, anonymization and pseudonymization, and management of keys, secrets and certificates.
